items.title: The Paytium: Mollie payment forms & donations plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.3. The 5.0.3 patch introduced ...
items.summary: The Paytium: Mollie payment forms & donations plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.3. The 5.0.3 patch introduced a wp_hash()/hash_equals() signature gate on the pt-paytium-user-data field, but left a second filter — pt_cf_checkout_meta(), registered on the pt_meta_values hook after the signed builder — that copies every $_POST['pt_form_field'][*] key verbatim into the payment meta array without any signature verification; this allows the pt-user-role value it copies to overwrite the signed path's output, after which paytium_user_data_processing() reads the persisted _pt-user-role post meta and passes it directly as the role argument to wp_insert_user(). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to register a new WordPress account with the administrator role and fully take over the site. Exploitation requires submitting a payment through a publicly-exposed [paytium] shortcode form and completing the resulting payment flow, after which the attacker can seize the new administrator account via the standard lost-password flow on their supplied email address.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-18467 是 WordPress 插件 Paytium: Mollie payment forms & donations 中的权限提升漏洞，影响 5.0.3 及之前的所有版本。该插件用于在站点上搭建 Mollie 支付表单与捐款表单，其结账流程会把用户提交的表单字段写入支付元数据，并据此在支付完成后创建或更新 WordPress 用户。5.0.3 版本曾针对 pt-paytium-user-data 字段引入由 wp_hash() 与 hash_equals() 构成的签名校验闸门，试图阻止未认证用户篡改用户角色；但该补丁只覆盖了一条数据通路。注册在 pt_meta_values 钩子、且执行顺序位于签名构建器之后的第二个过滤器 pt_cf_checkout_meta() 依然存在，它会把请求中 pt_form_field 下的每个键值原样复制进支付元数据数组，且不做任何签名校验。这样一来，被复制进去的 pt-user-role 值可以覆盖已签名路径的输出；随后 paytium_user_data_processing() 读取持久化的 _pt-user-role 文章元数据，并将其直接作为 role 参数传给 wp_insert_user()，缺少角色白名单校验。最终结果是未认证攻击者只要让某个公开暴露的 [paytium] 短代码表单完成一次支付流程，新注册的 WordPress 账号就可能被赋予 administrator 角色，从而完全接管站点。成功利用的前提是目标站点存在公开可访问的 [paytium] 表单并实际完成支付；获得管理员账号后，攻击者可通过注册时提供的邮箱走标准找回密码流程接管该账号。CVSS 3.1 评分为 9.8 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H)，属严重级别。NVD 未将其列入 KEV，相关来源字段也未标注在野利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 未认证即可借助公开支付/捐款表单把自建账号提升为管理员并接管整站，CVSS 9.8、利用门槛低；WordPress 电商与募捐类站点广泛使用此类短代码表单，暴露面大，应优先排查。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用即整站沦陷：攻击者获得 administrator 权限，可安装插件与主题、植入后门账号、窃取或篡改支付与业务数据，并可能横向影响同主机其他站点；CVSS 影响向量为 C:H/I:H/A:H，且无需任何凭据与用户交互。

items.title: GitLab Critical Patch Release: 19.4.1, 19.3.3, 19.2.7
items.summary:
On September 23, 2026, we released versions 19.4.1, 19.3.3, 19.2.7 for GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE).
These versions contain important bug and security fixes, and we strongly recommend that all self-managed GitLab installations be upgraded to
one of these versions immediately. GitLab.com is already running the patched version. GitLab Dedicated customers do not need to take action.
GitLab releases fixes for vulnerabilities in patch releases. There are two types of patch releases:
scheduled releases and ad-hoc critical patches for high-severity vulnerabilities. Scheduled releases are released twice a month on the second and fourth Wednesdays.
For more information, please visit our releases handbook and security FAQ.
You can see all of GitLab release blog posts here.
For security fixes, the issues detailing each vulnerability are made public on our
issue tracker
90 days after the release in which they were patched.
We are committed to ensuring that all aspects of GitLab that are exposed to customers or that host customer data are held to
the highest security standards. To maintain good security hygiene, it is highly recommended that all customers
upgrade to the latest patch release for their supported version. You can read more
best practices in securing your GitLab instance in our blog post.
Recommended Action
We strongly recommend that all installations running a version affected by the issues described below are upgraded to the latest version as soon as possible.
When no specific deployment type (omnibus, source code, helm chart, etc.) of a product is mentioned, it means all types are affected.

items.title: Improving Service Availability in KubeEdge-Based Architectures Using Lightweight Intrusion Detection
items.summary: The increasing adoption of the Internet of Things (IoT) and cloud computing has accelerated the evolution of edge computing paradigms [1]. Industry forecasts estimate that the number of connected IoT devices will reach approximately 50 billion by 2030, following an estimated 38 billion connections by 2025 [34], resulting in an unprecedented growth in data generation. This trend necessitates efficient, scalable, and secure data processing mechanisms at the network edge. Consequently, ensuring the reliable management and protection of IoT applications and devices has become a critical challenge. In this context, KubeEdge extends cloud-native capabilities to edge environments, enabling distributed orchestration while introducing new security concerns. This paper investigates the security of container images in IoT-driven and distributed edge architectures. Specifically, we analyze the impact of major security threats, including Denial of Service (DoS) attacks and malicious container deployments, on the availability and operational stability of KubeEdge-based systems. To address these challenges, we propose a lightweight Recommended Intrusion Detection Rule Set (RIDRS) tailored for resource-constrained edge environments. The proposed approach improves system resilience by enabling timely detection and mitigation of security threats. We define system stability as the ability to maintain consistent operational behavior and to recover autonomously under adversarial conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that RIDRS significantly reduces system downtime and enhances service availability, particularly in scenarios involving code injection and malicious pod deployment attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文关注 IoT 与云计算推动下边缘计算范式的发展，并指出到 2030 年全球连接 IoT 设备预计约 500 亿台、2025 年约 380 亿台，数据生成量空前增长，因此边缘侧需要高效、可扩展且安全的数据处理机制。KubeEdge 将云原生能力扩展到边缘环境，实现分布式编排的同时也引入了新的安全担忧。论文研究 IoT 驱动与分布式边缘架构中的容器镜像安全问题，重点分析拒绝服务（DoS）攻击和恶意容器部署等主要威胁对 KubeEdge 系统可用性与运行稳定性的影响。为应对这些挑战，作者提出一种面向资源受限边缘环境的轻量级推荐入侵检测规则集（RIDRS），通过及时检测和缓解安全威胁来提升系统韧性。文中将系统稳定性定义为在对抗条件下维持一致运行行为并能够自主恢复的能力。实验结果表明，RIDRS 能显著减少系统停机时间并提升服务可用性，尤其是在涉及代码注入和恶意 Pod 部署攻击的场景中。整体来看，该工作从边缘编排平台的实际约束出发，探索了用轻量规则检测增强 KubeEdge 服务可用性的可行路径，适合边缘计算、云原生安全与 IoT 安全方向的研究和工程人员参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: KubeEdge 等边缘编排平台常部署在资源受限、运维薄弱的节点，DoS 与恶意 Pod 部署会直接影响服务可用性。轻量级入侵检测规则集为边缘安全防护提供了低开销思路，值得 SOC 与边缘平台团队评估。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 KubeEdge、K3s 等边缘容器编排场景，用于提升恶意容器部署、代码注入和 DoS 攻击下的服务恢复能力，并可作为边缘节点侧检测规则设计的参考。
detection_signals_zh: 异常或未授权的 Pod 创建与部署事件
容器镜像来源、标签或哈希与基线不一致
边缘节点资源占用突增、连接数异常或服务响应超时
业务进程异常行为、非预期代码执行或运行时完整性变化
服务重启、Pod 驱逐或不可用状态频繁出现
defense_advice_zh: 在边缘节点部署轻量级检测规则，优先覆盖恶意 Pod 部署与 DoS 相关指标
结合镜像签名、镜像扫描与准入控制，限制未经验证的容器镜像运行
为边缘工作负载设置资源配额、限流与熔断策略，降低 DoS 对可用性的影响
建立边缘节点基线与异常行为告警，定期更新检测规则并验证误报率
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，并纳入边缘容器平台安全评估

items.title: Extracting CNNs in the Unknown-Architecture and Feedback-Agnostic Setting
items.summary: This paper studies the cryptanalytic extraction of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Existing cryptanalytic extraction attacks on CNNs assume that the network architecture is known, and try to recover model parameters.In this paper, we prove for the first time that the architecture assumption can be removed for CNNs with both max and average pooling. Our core finding is that the spatial geometry of the weight vectors recovered by existing parameter-recovery attacks naturally leaks the architecture. We formalize this geometry and establish its correspondence with the architectural knowledge of a convolutional layer: (1) The sparsity consistency with the convolution receptive field reveals the layer type, the kernel size, and the stride; (2) The numerical consistency with the kernel parameters reveals the padding mode and the output-channel number; (3) The structural consistency with the pooling operation reveals the pooling type, the window size, and the stride. Although the recovered vectors are obtained using different methods in the raw-output and hard label settings, their spatial geometry remains the same. Therefore, our architecture recovery is feedback-agnostic: combined with a parameter-recovery attack, it yields a complete cryptanalytic extraction framework that recovers both the architecture and the parameters in the black-box setting. Extensive experiments, including both layer-wise and end-to-end ones, on a wide range of CNNs demonstrate that simultaneously recovering the network architecture and the model parameters is practical.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究卷积神经网络（CNN）的密码分析式模型提取问题。既有的密码分析提取攻击普遍假设网络架构已知，攻击者只需在已知结构下恢复模型参数。本文首次证明：对于同时包含最大池化与平均池化的 CNN，这一架构假设可以被完全移除。核心发现是，现有参数恢复攻击所恢复出的权重向量，其空间几何特性会自然而然地泄漏架构信息。作者将该几何特性形式化，并建立起它与卷积层架构知识之间的对应关系：（1）与卷积感受野之间的稀疏一致性，可揭示层类型、卷积核大小与步长；（2）与卷积核参数之间的数值一致性，可揭示填充（padding）模式与输出通道数；（3）与池化操作之间的结构一致性，可揭示池化类型、窗口大小与步长。值得注意的是，虽然在原始输出（raw-output）与硬标签（hard label）两种反馈设定下，这些权重向量是由不同方法恢复得到的，但其空间几何特征保持相同，因此本文的架构恢复是“反馈无关”的：与任一参数恢复攻击结合，即可构成一个完整的密码分析提取框架，在黑盒条件下同时恢复网络架构与模型参数。作者在广泛的 CNN 上开展了大量实验，包含逐层（layer-wise）与端到端（end-to-end）两类设置，结果表明同时恢复网络架构与模型参数在实践中是可行的。该工作把 CNN 模型提取从“已知架构下的参数窃取”推进到“架构与参数联合窃取”，对模型知识产权保护与 API 安全具有直接含义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它把模型提取的威胁面从“参数窃取”扩展到“架构+参数联合窃取”，且不依赖已知架构、对原始输出与硬标签反馈均适用，直接削弱仅靠隐藏网络结构来保护模型的假设。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响以黑盒 API 形式对外提供 CNN 推理的服务方，尤其是图像分类、视觉检测类模型的商业 API；可迁移到任何通过查询-响应接口暴露模型能力的场景（含硬标签接口）的模型知识产权风险评估。
detection_signals_zh: API 侧出现大规模、系统化、覆盖输入空间特定区域的查询，明显偏离正常业务流量分布
针对输出层的细粒度探测：反复提交边界样本或接近决策边界的输入，以获取高精度或稳定输出
同一凭证/来源在短时间内对同一模型发起高频、批量、脚本化的推理请求
查询模式呈现出对特定层行为（如池化、卷积感受野）的探测意图，而非正常业务语义
输出精度被反复用于推断数值一致性，出现异常一致的查询-响应配对模式
defense_advice_zh: 对推理 API 实施严格的速率限制、配额与访问审计，按账号/来源统计查询量异常
对返回的置信度/概率进行量化、取整或只返回 top-k 标签，降低数值精度可利用性
对模型输出加入随机扰动或水印/指纹机制，便于事后溯源与窃取检测
建立面向模型提取的查询行为基线与告警规则，结合人机识别与信誉评分
对高价值模型限制调用权限与调用频次，并评估隐藏架构作为唯一防护手段的风险
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Cryptographic Security Is Not Enough: Privacy Gaps in the Renegade Decentralized Dark Pool
items.summary: Dark pools are designed to provide pre-trade privacy, liveness, and post-trade confidentiality - concealing order flow before execution and limiting information leakage after. Decentralized dark pools, such as Renegade, aim to replicate these properties without custodial risk, using secure multi-party computation (MPC) and zero-knowledge proofs for private order matching and verifiable settlement. We show that Renegade's cryptographic guarantees do not deliver these dark pool properties in practice. MPC-with-abort ensures correctness but not fairness: a party may learn the match result and abort without penalty, breaking pre-trade privacy. We demonstrate that the protocol's discovery layer further leaks trading intent before MPC even begins, and that sustained probing via selective abort can probabilistically reconstruct counterparty order history, threatening post-trade confidentiality. We also show that the absence of input-consistency checks prior to MPC execution enables a griefing attack using invalid state commitments requiring no real token holdings that continuously locks honest users' wallets and wastes compute, breaking liveness under sustained conditions. We further analyze over 700,000 Renegade transactions on Base and probe the P2P layer, finding that the network is effectively centralized: 88% of traffic routes through a handful of relayers, with only four nodes sustaining the P2P layer. Since relayers hold their users' wallet state in plaintext, this concentration means the system operates as a centralized orderbook in practice - reproducing off-chain the information asymmetry that dark pools are designed to eliminate. Together, our results show that cryptographic privacy does not imply dark pool security: pre-trade privacy, liveness, and post-trade confidentiality each require additional protocol-level guarantees beyond MPC correctness.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文《Cryptographic Security Is Not Enough: Privacy Gaps in the Renegade Decentralized Dark Pool》由 Prerna Arote、Adrian Saiz、Oriol Saguillo 与 Lucianna Kiffer 撰写，针对去中心化暗池 Renegade 展开系统性安全与隐私分析。暗池的核心承诺有四点：成交前隐私（pre-trade privacy，隐藏订单流）、活性（liveness，系统持续可用）、成交后机密性（post-trade confidentiality，限制事后信息泄露）以及无托管风险。Renegade 试图用安全多方计算（MPC）与零知识证明来实现私有订单撮合与可验证结算，从而在去中心化环境中复刻上述性质。

论文的核心论点是：密码学正确性并不等于暗池安全性。作者从多个层面给出反例。第一，MPC-with-abort（可中止的 MPC）只保证计算正确性，不保证公平性——参与方可以在获知撮合结果后无惩罚地中止协议，从而破坏成交前隐私。第二，协议的发现层（discovery layer）在 MPC 尚未开始之前就泄露交易意图。第三，通过持续的选择性中止进行探测，攻击者可以概率性地重建对手方的订单历史，威胁成交后机密性。第四，由于 MPC 执行前缺少输入一致性校验，存在一种无需真实持有代币的垃圾攻击（griefing），可用无效状态承诺持续锁定诚实用户的钱包并消耗算力，在持续条件下破坏活性。

在实证层面，作者分析了部署在 Base 链上超过 70 万笔 Renegade 交易，并对 P2P 层进行探测，发现该网络实际上是中心化的：88% 的流量经由少数几个 relayer 路由，仅有四个节点在支撑整个 P2P 层。由于 relayer 以明文形式持有用户钱包状态，这种集中度意味着系统在实践中退化为一个中心化订单簿，把暗池本应消除的信息不对称重新带回了链下。

论文适合区块链安全、隐私增强技术（PET）、MPC/零知识协议以及 DeFi 系统设计方向的读者阅读。其结论具有一般性：成交前隐私、活性与成交后机密性各自需要超出 MPC 正确性的额外协议层保证，仅依赖密码学原语无法达成暗池的安全目标。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 它揭示了「去中心化+MPC+ZK 即等于隐私」这一常见假设的失效路径：密码学正确性无法覆盖公平性、活性与元数据泄露。对设计或审计 DeFi 隐私协议、评估 MPC 撮合系统威胁模型的团队，是重要的负面案例与检查清单来源。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至所有基于 MPC 的私有撮合、拍卖、暗池与链下订单簿系统；适用于评估 relayer/P2P 层中心化风险、可中止协议的公平性缺陷，以及执行前输入一致性校验的缺失问题。对交易平台、DeFi 协议审计方与隐私协议设计者均有直接参考价值。
detection_signals_zh: relayer 流量集中度异常：单一或少数节点承载绝大部分 P2P 流量（论文观测到 88%）
频繁出现协议中止/abort 事件，尤其是同一对等方对多个会话的选择性中止模式
MPC 执行前的无效状态承诺提交激增，且提交地址无真实代币余额或持仓
用户钱包被反复锁定、交易长时间无法推进的活性下降告警
defense_advice_zh: 对私有撮合协议进行威胁建模时，将公平性、活性与元数据泄露与密码学正确性并列评估
在 MPC 执行前增加输入一致性校验，拒绝无真实资产支撑的状态承诺
对可中止协议引入惩罚或抵押机制，降低「先获知结果再中止」的收益
监控 relayer 层中心化指标，推动多运营商、多实现的路由冗余
对 relayer 的明文钱包状态存储进行加密与最小权限改造，缩小单点泄露面
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：将论文提出的四类性质缺口纳入内部 DeFi/MPC 协议评估基线

items.title: Metrics Failure in LLM-Based Code Vulnerability Repair: An Empirical Study and a Change-Aware Screen
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to the automated repair of C/C++ security vulnerabilities, and compile rate is a commonly reported proxy for progress: whether the generated patch compiles. We argue that compile rate is a scientifically unreliable metric for single-function vulnerability repair, and we support this with five controlled experiments over 203 vulnerable functions from Big-Vul, three open-source code LLMs (350M to 6.7B parameters), and three prompting strategies. Compile rate (i) barely responds to an intervention that substantially improves the generated code; (ii) is dominated by evaluation-harness and dataset artifacts rather than model quality, with about 64% of compile failures not attributable to the model, a share that is nearly invariant across models; (iii) shifts by 1.8 to 2.7 times on identical patches under a single compiler-standard flag, with zero regressions; (iv) ranks the three models in the opposite order to reference-similarity metrics; and (v) rewards non-repairs when used as an optimization target, since a compiler-feedback loop raises compile rate while similarity to the human fix falls, with manual inspection finding deletion- and placeholder-style non-repairs among the newly compiling outputs. The natural fallback, whole-function CodeBLEU, also fails: an unchanged copy of the vulnerable input outscores every model. We also examine diff_F1, a change-aware screen that scores only the edited region. It gives exactly zero credit to a no-op and near-zero credit to some, though not all, of the deletion-based gaming patches we observed, while still crediting genuine partial edits, so it may serve as a cheap screen before deeper, execution-based analysis. It is not a repair-quality metric, and we report where it falls short. Our findings argue for change-aware, execution-grounded evaluation of LLM-based vulnerability repair.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文对当前 LLM 自动修复 C/C++ 安全漏洞研究中广泛使用的评价指标提出系统性质疑。作者指出，编译率（compile rate，即生成的补丁能否通过编译）常被当作衡量修复进展的代理指标，但对于单函数级别的漏洞修复任务，它在科学上是不可靠的。为支撑这一论点，作者在 Big-Vul 数据集中选取 203 个易受攻击函数，使用三种开源代码大模型（参数量从 350M 到 6.7B）与三种提示策略，设计并执行了五组受控实验。主要发现包括：(一) 编译率对一个能显著改善生成代码质量的干预几乎不敏感，说明它无法反映真实进步；(二) 编译率主要由评测框架与数据集本身的伪影决定，而非模型能力，约 64% 的编译失败不能归因于模型，且该比例在不同模型间几乎不变；(三) 在完全相同的补丁上，仅调整一个编译器标准选项，编译率就会变动 1.8 至 2.7 倍，且没有任何回归发生，说明指标极度脆弱；(四) 编译率对三个模型的排序与基于参考相似度的指标排序完全相反；(五) 当把编译率作为优化目标时，它会奖励“非修复”行为——引入编译器反馈循环后编译率上升，但与人工修复的相似度下降，人工检查发现新增的可编译输出中存在删除式和占位符式的伪修复。作者随后考察了常见退路指标 whole-function CodeBLEU，发现同样失效：一个未改动的脆弱函数原始副本，其得分高于所有模型的输出。为此作者提出 change-aware 筛选指标 diff_F1，仅对编辑区域打分。该指标对空操作给出严格零分，对部分（并非全部）删除式投机补丁给出接近零分，同时仍能认可真实的局部修改，因此可作为更深入的、基于执行的修复质量分析之前的廉价预筛选。作者强调 diff_F1 并非修复质量指标，并明确报告了它的局限与失效场景，最终主张对基于 LLM 的漏洞修复应采用变更感知、执行落地的评测范式。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 大量 LLM 漏洞修复论文与安全自动化方案以编译率作为进步证据，本文用受控实验证明该指标可被编译器选项、评测框架伪影和优化目标“刷分”操纵，甚至奖励删除式伪修复。安全团队若据此类指标选型或验收修复工具，可能高估实际防护效果。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响 LLM 辅助漏洞修复的选型评测、模型榜单可信度、以及自动化修复流水线的质量门禁设计；可迁移到任何以“编译通过/测试通过”作为代理指标的代码生成与补丁生成场景。
detection_signals_zh: 评测报告中编译率与参考相似度指标（如 CodeBLEU）给出互相矛盾的模型排序
同一批补丁在更换编译器或编译标准后通过率出现数倍级跳变
补丁集中出现删除式修改或占位符式替换的“可编译但未修复”输出
编译率随编译器反馈迭代上升，而人工复核的修复正确性下降
defense_advice_zh: 不要将编译率单独作为 LLM 漏洞修复效果或工具选型的验收指标
在评测流程中加入变更感知筛选（如 diff_F1 类指标）作为前置过滤，剔除空操作与删除式伪修复
对候选补丁补充基于执行的验证（回归测试、漏洞复现用例、语义等价检查）而非仅编译
固定并披露编译器版本与标准选项，避免评测结果被编译器配置伪影左右
对自动修复流水线引入人工抽检环节，重点复核高编译率批次中的补丁内容

items.title: Comparative Evaluation of Static Embedding Models for HTTP Request Anomaly Detection
items.summary: Web applications are increasingly targeted by cyberattacks that exploit HTTP requests to evade security mechanisms. Traditional web application firewalls (WAFs) rely on rule-based approaches that often exhibit high false positive rates and limited adaptability. Recent studies have explored machine learning techniques and word embedding models to improve anomaly detection in HTTP traffic. This paper presents a benchmark for static embedding models, specifically Word2Vec, FastText, and Doc2Vec, within a unified, single-class classification framework. We propose HEDA (HTTP Embedding-Based Detection Architecture), a modular detection pipeline that combines static embedding representations with single-class anomaly detection models to detect anomalies at the request level. The approach operates in an unsupervised environment, where both the embedding models and detectors are trained exclusively on benign HTTP traffic. The proposed methodology is evaluated on three datasets with heterogeneous characteristics, including both synthetic and real traffic. The experimental results show that the choice of embedding representation significantly affects detection performance, and that FastText-based embeds produce the most consistent results across all datasets, achieving high detection rates while keeping false positive rates under control.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文面向 Web 应用层攻击检测场景，指出现有 Web 应用防火墙（WAF）主要依赖规则匹配，存在误报率高、对新型或变种 HTTP 请求适应性差的问题，并注意到近年已有研究尝试用机器学习与词嵌入模型提升 HTTP 流量异常检测效果，但缺乏对静态嵌入模型在统一框架下的系统对比。为此，作者提出 HEDA（HTTP Embedding-Based Detection Architecture），一个模块化的请求级检测流水线：先用静态嵌入模型把原始 HTTP 请求转换成稠密向量表示，再交由单类（single-class）异常检测器判断该请求是否偏离正常模式。论文的核心设计是完全无监督：嵌入模型与异常检测器都只在良性 HTTP 流量上训练，不需要攻击样本标注，从而适配真实环境中攻击样本稀缺、类别不平衡的现实。作者构建了一个基准评测，对比 Word2Vec、FastText 与 Doc2Vec 三种静态嵌入表示，并在三个特征异构的数据集（同时包含合成流量与真实流量）上评估整体流水线。实验结论包括：嵌入表示的选择对检测性能影响显著，即同一检测器搭配不同嵌入方式会得到差别较大的检测率与误报率；其中基于 FastText 的嵌入在三个数据集上表现最为一致，既能维持较高的检测率，又能把误报率控制在可接受范围内。论文的贡献可归纳为：一是提出可复用的模块化请求级检测架构 HEDA，二是给出静态嵌入模型在 HTTP 异常检测中的统一单类评测基准，三是通过跨数据集实验说明嵌入选择是影响 WAF 类检测系统效果的关键工程变量，并为后续研究提供了可比较的基线。适合读者：从事 Web 安全、WAF/NDR 检测工程、以及将机器学习应用于流量异常检测的研究人员与安全工程师。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 规则型 WAF 误报高、应变慢，该研究给出了无监督条件下用静态词嵌入做请求级异常检测的可比基准与架构，并指出嵌入选型显著影响检测率与误报率、FastText 表现最稳，对自建 WAF/流量检测流水线的选型与评测有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 Web 应用防火墙、API 网关、反向代理侧的请求级异常检测与影子验证；也可用于对现有规则引擎告警做二次降噪与聚类复核。需注意该方法只在良性流量上训练，上线前须用自有流量做误报率回归测试。
detection_signals_zh: 请求级异常分数超过历史基线阈值（由单类检测器输出）
同一客户端/会话在短时间内的请求向量分布偏离良性流量训练集中心
WAF 规则触发但随后被模型判定为正常的请求聚集，提示规则误报候选
编码方式、参数结构或请求路径异常罕见但与已知攻击签名不匹配的请求
defense_advice_zh: 在自有良性流量上复现 HEDA 式的单类流水线，优先对比 FastText 与 Word2Vec 嵌入对误报率的影响
采用影子模式并行运行模型评分与现有规则引擎，先观测告警质量再决定是否联动阻断
以误报率与召回率的联合指标做阈值标定，避免单一追求检测率导致运维告警疲劳
将模型异常分数作为规则告警的富化字段，用于优先级排序与人工复核队列
定期用新采集的良性流量增量更新嵌入与检测器，防止流量漂移导致误报上升

items.title: I Prove, Therefore I Am: Spatiotemporal Multi-Party Computation
items.summary: Secure multiparty computation (MPC) enables mutually distrustful parties to compute on private digital inputs. We initiate the study of spatiotemporal MPC, extending this paradigm to functionalities whose inputs additionally depend on physical facts such as the parties' locations, times, or trajectories. Such protocols must simultaneously hide spatiotemporal information and ensure its physical consistency: a malicious party should not be able to make the functionality operate on a spatiotemporal input inconsistent with its actual physical state. The main conceptual challenge is to formulate extraction of spatiotemporal information within the simulation-based security framework. We introduce arguments of spatiotemporal knowledge, following the principle "I prove, therefore I am:" rather than defining physical presence directly through a mathematical relation, we define it operationally through the ability to complete a sound spatiotemporal verification protocol. Accordingly, an extractor recovers a spatiotemporal point from a successful prover and certifies its physical validity by using the extracted prover to succeed in an auxiliary spatiotemporal verification protocol. Building on this notion, we define universally composable (UC) security for spatiotemporal MPC, capturing privacy, physical consistency, and composability. We provide constructions achieving this new MPC notion. We first construct UC-secure commit-and-prove of spatiotemporal knowledge: in the CRS model under LWE against quantum provers without pre-shared entanglement, and in the QROM against quantum provers with unbounded pre-shared entanglement. Using these protocols, we obtain UC-secure spatiotemporal MPC from semi-honest post-quantum MPC. We also extend our framework to support quantum functionalities with classical spatiotemporal input.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文开创性地提出并研究“时空多方安全计算”(spatiotemporal MPC), 把传统 MPC 的输入从纯数字数据扩展为同时依赖物理事实(如参与方所处位置、时间、运动轨迹)的功能。这类协议面临双重目标: 一方面必须隐藏时空信息(隐私性), 另一方面必须保证时空输入的物理一致性——恶意参与方不能迫使功能运行在与自身真实物理状态不符的时空输入上。核心概念难点在于: 如何在基于模拟(simulation-based)的安全框架内对时空信息进行“提取”。为此作者提出“时空知识论证”(arguments of spatiotemporal knowledge), 遵循“我证明故我在”的原则: 不直接用数学关系定义物理在场, 而是操作性地把物理在场定义为“能够完成一个健全(sound)的时空验证协议”的能力。据此, 提取器可从成功的证明者处恢复出一个时空点, 并通过驱动被提取出的证明者在辅助时空验证协议中成功, 来认证该时空点具有物理有效性。在此概念之上, 论文定义了时空 MPC 的通用可组合(UC)安全性, 同时刻画隐私性、物理一致性与可组合性, 并给出满足该新 MPC 概念的构造。作者首先构造 UC 安全的“时空知识提交-证明”协议: 在 CRS 模型下基于 LWE 假设, 可抵抗无预共享纠缠的量子证明者; 在 QROM(量子随机预言机模型)下, 可抵抗拥有无界预共享纠缠的量子证明者。随后利用这些构造, 从半诚实后量子 MPC 出发得到 UC 安全的时空 MPC。论文还把框架扩展到支持经典时空输入下的量子功能。适合密码学理论、量子安全协议与分布式系统方向的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 物理世界的位置与时间正逐步成为访问控制与计算协议的输入维度。该工作首次为“时空输入”给出 UC 可组合安全的形式化基础, 提示物理在场证明必须与密码协议绑定设计, 并对后量子场景下的抗纠缠攻击提出明确安全边界。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到地理位置感知的分布式密钥管理、去中心化身份中的物理在场证明、后量子安全多方计算协议设计, 以及需同时满足隐私与物理一致性的物联网/边缘协同计算场景。

items.title: Staged Multi-step UTXO Workflows via Recursive Invariants
items.summary: Stateless UTXO-style execution validates transactions from local and referenced data, supporting parallel validation and predictable serialized-size/weight accounting, but multi-step workflows must explicitly thread state through outputs. However, a prepared next-step transaction may become stale when another valid spend confirms first, shifting consistency maintenance, off-chain tracking, and transaction rebuilding to the protocol boundary and potentially increasing coordination cost and latency. Explicitly addressing this gap, recursive invariants (RIs) provide a transaction-level logic and toolchain in which workflow rules are predicates over a transaction's inputs and indexed successor positions referenced by the RI. Realizing such a successor causes the accepted transaction to re-check its predecessor's RI one step later, carrying the workflow rule forward without application-level shared mutable state or executable logic attached to outputs; repeated one-step checks thereby preserve validation-time locality and make validation work explicitly accountable. Many successor clauses are not decidable when the current transaction is validated, so our small statically typed DSL uses Kleene-style three-valued semantics over true, false, and unknown to defer future-dependent obligations until they become checkable. Alongside the DSL, we formalize UTXO validation and ledger extension in our model, identify the validation-time-evaluable one-step fragment, prove the deduction system sound for the three-valued semantics, and give corresponding transaction-validation and ledger-extension algorithms. Notably, a prototype RI interpreter and benchmarking toolchain evaluate six practice-motivated workflows; the reported traces show approximately linear cumulative validation-cost proxy growth while illustrating staged constraints without committing each step to a preconstructed successor transaction.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文针对无状态 UTXO（未花费交易输出）风格的账本执行模型提出了一套名为「递归不变量」（Recursive Invariants, RI）的交易级逻辑与工具链，用以支撑多步工作流。背景问题是：UTXO 模型只依据本地数据和被引用数据即可验证交易，天然支持并行验证，且序列化体积/权重可预测；但多步业务流程必须显式地把状态在输出中逐级传递。作者指出一个关键缺口——预先构造好的「下一步交易」可能因为另一笔合法的花费先被确认而失效，于是链下跟踪、冲突处理与交易重建等一致性维护负担被推到了协议边界，带来协调成本与时延上升。

RI 的核心思路是：把工作流规则写成对某笔交易的输入与被索引的后继位置的谓词（predicate），而不是把可执行逻辑或共享可变状态附着在输出上。当某个被引用的后继交易被接受时，被接受交易会在「一步之后」重新检查其前驱的 RI，从而把工作流规则向前携带；连续的单步检查既保持了验证期局部性，又使验证工作可被明确归责与计量。由于许多后继子句在当前交易被验证时并不可判定，作者设计了一个小型静态类型 DSL，采用 Kleene 式三值语义（真、假、未知），把依赖未来的义务推迟到可检查的时刻。

论文形式化了该模型下的 UTXO 验证与账本扩展规则，刻画了「验证期可求值的一步片段」，证明了演绎系统相对三值语义的可靠性（soundness），并给出对应的交易验证算法与账本扩展算法。一个原型 RI 解释器与基准测试工具链评估了六个源自实践的流程；报告出的轨迹显示累计验证成本代理指标近似线性增长，同时展示了分阶段约束能力，且无需为每一步预先承诺一个已构造好的后继交易。

适合读者：区块链协议与智能合约研究者、UTXO/无状态执行模型的设计者、形式化方法与程序语言（三值语义、类型系统）方向的研究者，以及关注交易验证可并行性、可计量性与链下协调成本的工程团队。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: UTXO 生态的多步合约与工作流长期受困于「预构造后继交易被前置花费作废」导致的链下协调与重放成本。RI 用交易级谓词加三值语义把未来依赖推迟到可验证时点，为可并行验证、验证成本可计量提供了形式化基础，对无状态客户端与 L2 设计有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 UTXO 系公链的脚本/合约工作流、通道与状态通道式的分步协议、无状态验证节点与轻客户端、以及需要并行验证与确定性资源计量的账本场景；DSL 与三值演绎系统也可作为其他「未来依赖验证」问题的形式化模板。
defense_advice_zh: 评估在现有 UTXO 验证流程中引入「一步后继检查」的可行性，重点测量其验证成本与并行度影响。
关注 RI 谓词的可判定片段边界，避免在节点验证路径上引入不可终止或高开销的求值逻辑。
若计划实现类似机制，应按论文的三值语义明确区分「假」与「未知」，防止未知被误判为失败而导致交易被错误拒绝。

items.title: On the Construction of Trapdoor Claw-Free Functions with Certifiable Key
items.summary: Trapdoor claw-free functions (TCFs) underpin much of classical-quantum cryptographic interaction, yet every TCF-based protocol states its guarantees relative to an honestly generated key. We give a family-agnostic abstraction of key certification for (noisy) TCF constructions, built on two notions: a certifiable key relation, an NP relation capturing a family's honest keys with witnesses recoverable from the trapdoor; and certified key generation, which emits with each key a certificate of membership satisfying completeness, certificate soundness with extractability, and key privacy. We instantiate certifiable key relations for different constructions, each met generically by a zero-knowledge argument of knowledge for the relation. As our main application, a generic compiler turns any TCF-based proof of quantumness into a zero-knowledge one, with each security property following from its counterpart in the certification scheme. Finally, we delimit the primitive's reach: for protocols resting on injective invariance, an accepting certificate is itself a family distinguisher, leaking exactly the bit such protocols must hide.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究的是量子-经典密码交互中广泛使用的陷门无爪函数（Trapdoor Claw-Free Functions, TCF）的密钥可信性问题。现有几乎所有基于 TCF 的密码协议都默认假设密钥由诚实方生成，并在此前提下证明安全性，一旦密钥本身不可信，协议的安全保证就可能失效。作者提出一个与具体函数族无关的密钥认证抽象框架，该框架建立在两个核心概念之上：第一是可认证密钥关系（certifiable key relation），即用一个 NP 关系来精确刻画某个 TCF 函数族的诚实密钥，同时保证其见证可以从陷门中恢复；第二是认证密钥生成（certified key generation），它在输出每个密钥时附带一份成员资格证书，并满足完备性、带可提取性的证书可靠性以及密钥隐私三条性质。作者针对不同的 TCF 构造实例化了相应的可认证密钥关系，并用零知识知识论证（ZKPoK）以通用方式满足这些关系。作为主要应用，论文给出一个通用编译器，能够把任意基于 TCF 的量子性证明（proof of quantumness）转化为零知识版本，且编译后协议的每一条安全性都可从其认证方案中的对应性质推导出来。最后，作者刻画了该原语的能力边界：对于依赖单射不变性（injective invariance）的协议，一个被接受的证书本身就是一个函数族区分器，会恰好泄漏这类协议必须隐藏的那个比特。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: TCF 是量子性证明与经典-量子密码协议的基础构件，而密钥可信性长期被默认假设。该工作为密钥认证提供通用抽象，并给出零知识化的通用编译器，对后量子与量子密码协议的设计与安全证明有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到基于 TCF 的量子性证明、零知识证明系统、经典-量子交互协议以及密钥认证机制的设计与安全性评估；其边界结论也提示在依赖单射不变性的协议中引入证书可能引入新的泄漏面。
defense_advice_zh: 在采用 TCF 的协议设计与评审中，显式考虑密钥来源可信性，并评估引入可认证密钥关系与证书机制的可行性与代价。

items.title: Reliable Federated TinyML Deployment for IoT Security
items.summary: The growing deployment of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has increased the need for privacy-preserving intrusion detection systems that operate directly on resource-constrained hardware. Federated Learning enables collaborative model training without sharing raw data, but conventional federated models are often too large and unstable for deployment on microcontroller-class devices. TinyML techniques enable compact neural networks but are typically designed for inference-only workloads. This work investigates combining Federated Learning with TinyML-based model compression for intrusion detection in IoT environments. We evaluate compression strategies including knowledge distillation, structured pruning, and quantization within a federated training pipeline. Preliminary results show that training stability plays a critical role in federated TinyML systems. In particular, server-coordinated cosine learning-rate scheduling improves Attack Recall from 46.7% to 93.85% while enabling substantial model compression and efficient edge deployment. These findings provide insights for designing lightweight and privacy preserving intrusion detection systems for IoT devices.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 针对物联网设备大规模部署后产生的隐私保护型入侵检测需求，本文研究如何让检测模型直接运行在资源极度受限的微控制器级硬件上。传统联邦学习虽能在不共享原始数据的前提下协同训练模型，但常规联邦模型的体积和训练不稳定性使其难以落地到这类边缘设备；而 TinyML 技术虽能提供紧凑神经网络，却大多只面向推理场景，缺乏可用的联邦训练流程。作者因此系统性地考察了将联邦学习与 TinyML 模型压缩相结合用于 IoT 入侵检测的可行性，并在同一联邦训练流水线中对比了知识蒸馏、结构化剪枝与量化等压缩策略。初步实验表明，训练稳定性是联邦 TinyML 系统的决定性因素：在压缩后的紧凑模型上进行联邦训练时，若不加以控制，聚合过程会出现明显退化，导致攻击类样本召回率极低。作者进一步发现，由服务器统一协调的余弦学习率调度能够显著缓解该问题，将 Attack Recall 从 46.7% 提升至 93.85%，同时仍保持可观的模型压缩率与高效的边缘部署能力。论文的核心贡献在于揭示了压缩与联邦训练叠加时的稳定性瓶颈，并给出了一种低开销的调度层修复手段，为设计轻量、隐私保护且可靠的 IoT 入侵检测系统提供了实证依据与工程洞见。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 边缘侧联邦 IDS 是 IoT 安全的重要落地形态。该工作提醒防守方：模型压缩与联邦聚合叠加会严重损害攻击召回率，仅靠压缩指标评估会误判可用性，必须做端到端稳定性与召回率回归验证。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至工业 IoT、智能家居、MCU 网关等需要在本地完成推理、不便上传原始流量的场景；也可用于自建联邦入侵检测系统的压缩方案选型、训练调优与上线前验收基线设计。
defense_advice_zh: 在部署压缩后的联邦边缘检测模型前，必须对攻击类样本召回率做端到端回归测试，不能仅看准确率与模型体积
在联邦聚合服务器侧引入并记录学习率调度等训练稳定性指标，将客户端更新分布的异常漂移纳入监控
对边缘模型建立版本与指标基线，模型重新压缩或再训练后若召回率明显下降应触发回滚
将边缘检测设备的模型更新行为纳入资产与配置管理，避免未经评估的静默降级部署
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: MimicSat: A Reconfigurable Cyber-Physical Testbed For Small Satellite Systems and Cybersecurity Research
items.summary: MimicSat provides a common experimental environment for examining how changes in satellite subsystem behavior propagate to mission outcomes across software-based and hardware-based execution. Its design is motivated by controlled spacecraft cybersecurity studies involving attacks, faults, and defensive responses. In MimicSat, a mission encompasses the spacecraft and ground activities required to achieve defined objectives, and an experiment consists of one or more mission runs used to study selected conditions or interventions. To support such studies, MimicSat offers software-based and hardware-based execution environments that implement the same mission functions and data exchanges, while allowing specific functions to be realized differently. A shared mission definition preserves command and telemetry semantics across environments, and collected observations retain provenance about the originating participants and acquisition paths. As a result, mission behavior can be compared across execution configurations without redefining the surrounding mission. This paper presents the architectural principles of MimicSat, its software and hardware execution forms, and their integrated operation. MimicSat also supports satellite systems engineering, mission operations, resilience studies, and related experimental use cases.

llm_summary.summary_zh: MimicSat 是一个面向小型卫星系统与网络安全研究的可重构网络-物理（cyber-physical）测试床，目标是为受控的航天器网络安全研究提供统一、可对照的实验环境，用以考察卫星子系统行为的变化如何传播并影响最终任务结果。论文明确区分两个核心概念：『任务（mission）』指为达成既定目标所必需的星上与地面活动集合；『实验（experiment）』则由一次或多次任务运行组成，用于研究选定的条件或干预（如攻击、故障注入、防御响应）。为支撑这类研究，MimicSat 同时提供基于软件与基于硬件的两种执行环境，二者实现相同的任务功能与数据交换，但允许某些特定功能以不同方式实现（例如部分子系统以真实硬件在环方式运行，其余部分由软件模拟），从而在保持接口一致的前提下获得不同的保真度。平台通过一份共享的任务定义，保证指令与遥测语义在软件环境和硬件环境中保持一致；同时，所有采集到的观测数据都保留来源信息（provenance），记录涉及的参与者以及数据获取路径。由此，研究者可以在不重新定义周边任务的前提下，直接跨执行配置对比任务行为，实现软件形态与硬件形态之间的可复现对照。论文的主要贡献是阐述 MimicSat 的架构原则、其软件与硬件执行形态以及两者的集成运行方式，并说明该平台除网络安全研究外，还可支持卫星系统工程、任务操作、韧性（resilience）研究等相关实验用例。整体而言，它试图解决航天安全研究中实验条件难以控制、结果难以复现、软硬件结论难以互相比对的问题。适合航天与卫星安全研究者、网络-物理系统测试床设计者以及负责航天任务安全的工程与运营人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 卫星与航天器安全研究长期缺乏可复现、可对照的实验环境，攻击或故障对任务级结果的影响难以量化。MimicSat 提供软硬件一致的执行形态与带来源溯源的观测数据，使防御方能在受控条件下验证检测与响应策略，对航天系统安全评估具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至星上软件与地面段的安全测试、硬件在环（HIL）攻防演练、卫星供应链与任务韧性评估，以及更广义的工控/ICS 类网络-物理测试床设计。
defense_advice_zh: 评估将该类测试床思路引入内部卫星/航天任务安全实验，建立软件仿真与硬件在环两条执行路径的行为一致性基线。
重视观测数据的来源溯源（provenance）设计，将其用于区分异常来自真实子系统、模拟组件还是采集链路，提升取证与误报分析质量。
在引入攻击/故障注入实验时，明确实验范围与隔离边界，避免测试活动影响真实地面段或运行中的任务系统。

items.title: FASTAR: FRI Accelerator for Scalable Transparent ARguments of Knowledge
items.summary: Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) enable a prover to cryptographically convince a verifier of the validity of a statement without revealing any underlying secrets, forming a foundational primitive for verifiable computation. The ZKP landscape is undergoing a fundamental shift from classic zk-SNARKs such as Groth16, which rely on trusted setup and are vulnerable to quantum adversaries, toward transparent, post-quantum constructions such as zk-STARK. These systems achieve post-quantum security by relying solely on collision-resistant hash functions, however, at the cost of substantial computational overhead. In particular, the Fast Reed--Solomon Interactive Oracle Proof of Proximity (FRI) protocol dominates prover complexity, generating massive data volumes, repeated Merkle-tree commitments, and irregular memory access patterns that limit performance and energy efficiency on general-purpose processors. To address these challenges, this work proposes FASTAR, a novel FPGA-based accelerator for the FRI protocol. Unlike accelerators that pursue fixed high-performance kernels on expensive ASIC process nodes, FASTAR adopts a constraint-driven design methodology. Our framework is implemented with High-Level Synthesis (HLS) and composed of fully parameterizable building blocks for the major stages of FRI, including polynomial evaluation, recursive split-and-fold, and Merkle-tree construction. From user-provided board specifications, FASTAR automatically generates hardware implementations tailored to the resource and memory constraints of the target FPGA, enabling deployment across a wide range of platforms without manual redesign.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
零知识证明（ZKP）允许证明者在不泄露底层秘密的前提下，向验证者密码学地证明某个陈述有效，是「可验证计算」的基础原语。当前 ZKP 技术栈正在经历一次根本性转向：以 Groth16 为代表的经典 zk-SNARK 依赖可信设置（trusted setup），并且在量子攻击者面前不安全；而 zk-STARK 等透明（transparent）、后量子（post-quantum）构造仅依赖抗碰撞哈希函数即可获得后量子安全性，代价是巨大的计算开销。论文指出，在这类系统中，Fast Reed–Solomon Interactive Oracle Proof of Proximity（FRI）协议主导了证明者（prover）的复杂度：它会产生海量数据、反复执行 Merkle 树承诺，并呈现不规则的访存模式，从而在通用处理器上严重限制性能与能效。

针对上述问题，作者提出 FASTAR —— 一个面向 FRI 协议的新型 FPGA 加速器。与那些在昂贵 ASIC 工艺节点上追求固定高性能内核的加速器不同，FASTAR 采用「约束驱动」（constraint-driven）的设计方法学。该框架使用高层次综合（HLS）实现，由完全可参数化的构建块组成，覆盖 FRI 的主要阶段：多项式求值（polynomial evaluation）、递归拆分与折叠（recursive split-and-fold）以及 Merkle 树构造。系统以用户提供的开发板规格（板卡资源、内存约束等）作为输入，自动生成为目标 FPGA 的资源与存储约束量身定制的硬件实现，从而无需人工重新设计即可在多种平台上部署。

论文的核心贡献可归纳为三点：一是明确了 FRI 是 zk-STARK 证明者性能的主导瓶颈，并刻画了其数据量、重复承诺与访存不规整这三大硬件痛点；二是提出了一种可参数化、可自动生成硬件配置的 HLS 框架，把 FPGA 加速从「手工调优」推进到「按板卡约束自动实例化」；三是强调可移植性——同一套设计思路可覆盖从低成本到高端的多样化 FPGA 平台，避免绑定单一 ASIC 节点。

该工作属于密码工程 / 硬件加速方向，适合零知识证明工程实现者、可验证计算基础设施团队、FPGA/HLS 硬件工程师以及对后量子密码部署成本敏感的研究者阅读。需要注意的是，摘要未给出具体实验数据、加速比数字或与其他加速器（如 GPU / ASIC）的对比结果，因此其性能宣称仍需查阅正文验证。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: ZKP 正从可信设置型 SNARK 迁移到后量子、透明的 STARK，而 FRI 是证明成本的主要来源。FASTAR 表明可用 FPGA+HLS 以约束驱动方式自动生成可参数化硬件，降低后量子可验证计算在各类平台上的部署门槛，对需要大规模 ZKP 的隐私与可验证计算基础设施有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移到 zk-STARK 类证明系统的证明者侧加速、区块链/rollup 证明服务、隐私计算与可验证计算平台的基础设施选型；也提示安全团队在评估后量子迁移成本时，需要把硬件加速层纳入考量。
defense_advice_zh: 在评估 ZKP 相关基础设施时，将证明者侧的硬件加速方案（FPGA/GPU/ASIC）与后量子安全性需求一并纳入成本与风险模型
关注透明式（trusted-setup-free）证明系统的迁移路径，避免继续依赖对量子攻击者不安全的经典 SNARK 构造
对该论文的实验数据、加速比与资源占用进行复现性核查，再决定是否纳入技术选型
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Trust in Edge-Enabled IoT Security: Features, Challenges and Research Directions
items.summary: Providing autonomous intelligence, pervasive connectivity and usability to human life and industry has led to the emergence of the Internet of Things (IoT). To support time-sensitive and resource-constrained applications, IoT systems nowadays increasingly rely on edge computing. This brings computation and decision-making closer to end devices. In edge-enabled IoT architecture, latency and communication overhead are reduced, but interactions among a larger and more diverse set of devices, edge nodes, services, and data sources are introduced as well. In such environments, security and privacy mechanisms provide the foundation for protection, while trust management can assess the reliability of interacting entities and adapting secure decisions. In this paper, we systematically review the current state of trust management in edge-enabled IoT. To this end, we propose a comprehensive taxonomy that maps physical, network, and application architectural IoT layers against the consumer, commercial, industrial, and infrastructure IoT domains. We further investigate state-of-art research based on their trust design, how trust integrated into secure IoT operations, the attacks that effect trust management process. Based on these findings, we identify key gaps in current research and outline future directions for context-aware and adaptive trust management in edge-enabled IoT.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文是一篇系统性综述，聚焦边缘计算赋能物联网（Edge-Enabled IoT）环境下的信任管理（Trust Management）问题。研究背景在于：物联网为人类生活与工业生产提供了自主智能、泛在连接与易用性，而为了支撑时延敏感、资源受限的应用（如工业控制、车联网、实时视频分析等），现代 IoT 系统日益依赖边缘计算，将计算与决策能力下沉到靠近终端设备的位置。这种架构降低了时延与通信开销，但代价是引入了数量更大、异构程度更高的交互主体——包括各类终端设备、边缘节点、服务与数据源，从而显著扩大了攻击面与信任决策的复杂度。作者指出，在这一环境中，安全与隐私机制构成保护的基础，而信任管理则用于评估交互实体的可靠性，并据此自适应地调整安全决策（例如是否授权访问、是否采纳某节点上报的数据）。论文的核心方法是对边缘赋能 IoT 中的信任管理现状进行系统化综述：首先提出一个综合性分类法（taxonomy），将 IoT 的物理层、网络层、应用层等架构层次与消费者、商业、工业、基础设施四类 IoT 应用域进行交叉映射，从而为梳理零散研究提供统一坐标；随后在此框架下考察最新研究，分析其信任设计方式、信任如何被集成进安全的 IoT 操作流程，以及哪些攻击会破坏或操纵信任管理过程（如信任值污染、恶意节点伪装、女巫攻击、数据投毒等对信任评估的干扰）。主要贡献包括：一是建立层次—域交叉的可复用分类体系；二是对信任设计、信任与安全机制集成方式、面向信任的攻击面进行了归纳对比；三是识别出当前研究的关键空白，例如缺乏上下文感知与自适应能力、跨域信任的可迁移性不足、以及面向动态边缘拓扑的信任评估与隐私保护的平衡问题；四是提出面向未来研究的若干方向。该工作适合关注 IoT/边缘安全架构、零信任与信任评估、以及工业物联网安全治理的研究人员与安全架构师阅读，属于概念性、综述性成果，不包含可直接落地的检测规则或漏洞细节。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 边缘 IoT 的信任管理直接决定设备与节点间能否安全授权与数据采信。该综述提供的层次—域分类法与信任攻击面梳理，可帮助安全团队在架构评审与零信任落地时定位信任机制的设计缺口与评估维度。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于工业物联网、车联网、边缘计算平台与多租户 IoT 服务的信任评估与安全架构设计；其分类法可作为内部威胁建模、供应商安全评估与合规审查的参考框架。
defense_advice_zh: 在边缘 IoT 架构评审中，将信任评估的输入源、更新频率与失效回退策略显式文档化
对信任评估结果被单个节点或单一数据源主导的情况保持警惕，避免信任值被污染后引发级联授权错误
将信任管理与既有身份认证、访问控制、日志审计结合，形成可观测的信任决策链路
关注跨域（消费/商业/工业/基础设施）信任迁移时的策略一致性，避免信任域边界成为盲区
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: SigNoz from v0.8.0 before v0.143.0 defaults the JWT tokenizer signing secret (tokenizer::jwt::secret, set via SIGNOZ_TOKENIZER_JWT_SECRET or the deprecated SIGNOZ_JWT_SECRET) to...
items.summary: SigNoz from v0.8.0 before v0.143.0 defaults the JWT tokenizer signing secret (tokenizer::jwt::secret, set via SIGNOZ_TOKENIZER_JWT_SECRET or the deprecated SIGNOZ_JWT_SECRET) to an empty string, and Config.Validate() does not reject the empty value, so a deployment that does not configure a secret starts up and both signs and verifies session tokens with an empty HMAC key. Because the JWT tokenizer was the default provider, any such deployment is affected. An unauthenticated attacker who knows the ID of an existing user can forge a valid session token for that user — including an administrator — by signing the id, orgId and email claims with an empty key; the organization ID (and whether an email is registered) can be obtained without authentication from /api/v2/sessions/context. A forged refresh token can be exchanged at /api/v2/sessions/rotate for a new token pair and cannot be revoked, so it remains usable for its full lifetime (30 days by default). Fixed in v0.143.0, which requires a JWT secret when the jwt provider is selected and changes the default provider to opaque.

items.title: Klever-Go: Elasticsearch bulk / painless injection via on-chain account name ->  explorer/indexer data forgery
items.summary: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. items.title: Klever-Go: Unauthenticated WebSocket /subscribe: no read-size limit, no connection cap, permissive origin -> remote node memory/goroutine exhaustion (DoS)
items.summary: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. Prior to 1.7.20, the default-open GET /subscribe endpoint in network/api/websocket/routes.go accepts unauthenticated WebSocket clients with permissive origin handling, does not call SetReadLimit to bound message size, and has no live-connection cap. SocketHub.HandleClientInsertion also accepts an unbounded address list that grows addressSubscription, and client.loopIn continues reading without a size limit, allowing one client to grow subscription maps or many clients to retain goroutines, buffered channels, and descriptors. The global HTTP request throttler does not count upgraded live WebSocket connections. Because the REST and WebSocket API runs in the node process, memory or scheduler exhaustion can crash the node and interrupt P2P and consensus participation. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.20.

items.title: Klever-Go: Zombie-order theft: `Buy` missing `IsClaimed` guard in native marketplace
items.summary: Klever-Go is the Go implementation of the Klever blockchain protocol. Prior to 1.7.20, the native marketplace function core/kapp/market/market.go Buy does not check IsClaimed before accepting a bid. A seller can use the Claim seller-accept branch to settle a resting-bid auction while leaving the claimed order loadable with a future EndTime and stale CurrentBid and CurrentBidder values. A later bidder can submit a higher bid, be debited, and cause the previous bidder to receive a refund even though the NFT has already been delivered. Because Claim and CancelOrder reject the later bidder when IsClaimed is true, the later bidder cannot obtain the NFT or recover the funds. This issue is fixed in version 1.7.20.

items.title: s2s-proxy accepts untrusted client certificates
items.summary: All published s2s-proxy versions through 0.2.2 are affected. In versions 0.1.16 through 0.2.2, TLS server listeners use Go's RequireAnyClientCert mode when skipCAVerification is false. This mode checks that the client holds the certificate's private key but does not verify the certificate against the configured CA. An attacker can therefore use a self-signed certificate and key to establish a TLS and yamux connection, then invoke RPCs allowed by the proxy's configuration and Temporal credentials. No certificate or private key trusted by the deployment, and no Temporal credential, is required.

items.summary: In Flatpak before 1.18.1, the revokefs writer, used by the flatpak-system-helper to receive repository data from unprivileged callers, validated file paths by rejecting literal .. components but did not prevent symlink traversal. In particular, an attacker could use this to tamper with ostree commit objects in the system repository after they passed signature verification, enabling root-controlled file writes to attacker-chosen paths and local root privilege escalation.

items.title: Moquette client IDs can cause cross-session H2 durable-queue corruption
items.summary: Moquette is a lightweight Java MQTT broker. items.title: Pake grants unrestricted IPC access to every HTTPS origin loaded in generated applications
items.summary:
Pake turns a website into a desktop application built on Tauri. Every application it generates inherits two settings from the upstream template, and together they hand native functionality to untrusted web content.



The first is in src-tauri/capabilities/default.json, which grants IPC access with "remote": { "urls": ["https://*.*"] }. That wildcard tells Tauri to accept IPC from any HTTPS origin, not just the site the application was built to wrap. The second is "withGlobalTauri": true in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, which puts window.__TAURI__.core.invoke() in reach of ordinary page JavaScript.



Tauri's access control list only checks plugin commands, the ones prefixed with plugin:. Commands the application registers itself through generate_handler!, known as app commands, are never checked against the ACL. So once an origin holds IPC access, it can call every app command with nothing else standing in the way. Pake registers download_file as an app command, and it does not appear in the permissions list because it does not need to.



The practical effect is that any script running on any HTTPS page inside a Pake application can invoke the application's native commands. That includes third-party script the wrapped site loads on its own, such as analytics, advertising, or a compromised CDN. Anyone distributing their own Pake application gets the same access without asking for it. Chained with the path traversal in download_file that is tracked separately as CVE-2026-82635, this reaches arbitrary file write and persistent code execution.

items.title: jackson-databind: unbounded growth of the type id cache in TypeDeserializerBase retains every unknown raw type ID
items.summary: TypeDeserializerBase._findDeserializer() in FasterXML jackson-databind caches the resolved deserializer under the raw, attacker-supplied type ID. When name-based polymorphism is configured with a fallback, for example @JsonTypeInfo(use = Id.NAME, defaultImpl = ...), every distinct unrecognized type ID resolves to the same fallback deserializer but is retained as its own key in the _deserializers map. That map has no configurable bound and lives for the lifetime of the type deserializer, so an attacker who can repeatedly supply fresh unknown type IDs causes monotonic memory retention across requests. The reporter observed 10,000 retained entries from 10,000 distinct unknown IDs, against a single entry for a control that repeated one unknown ID the same number of times, isolating attacker-controlled key cardinality from request volume. Exploitation requires an application that enables name-based polymorphism with a defaultImpl or equivalent fallback, accepts attacker-influenced type IDs, and reuses a long-lived ObjectMapper across requests. The fix stops caching fallback resolutions for unrecognized IDs and bounds both the number of cached entries and the length of a cacheable type ID.

items.title: jackson-core: UTF8DataInputJsonParser._reportInvalidToken() does not honor maxErrorTokenLength, allowing unbounded StringBuilder growth
items.summary: UTF8DataInputJsonParser._reportInvalidToken() in FasterXML jackson-core builds the offending-token text for its error message by appending Java identifier characters to a StringBuilder in a loop that has no upper bound. Unlike the three sibling parser implementations, including UTF8StreamJsonParser, it never consults ErrorReportConfiguration.getMaxErrorTokenLength() (default 256). A malformed token supplied to a parser created through JsonFactory.createParser(DataInput) is therefore accumulated in full. No StreamReadConstraints setting mitigates this: maxDocumentLength cannot be applied to DataInput sources at all, and maxStringLength does not cover this path because the accumulation bypasses ReadConstrainedTextBuffer. The reporter measured a 20,000,109-character exception message from a 20-million-character malformed token on the DataInput path, against 367 characters for identical input on the InputStream path. Scaling the payload drives the StringBuilder, which also incurs byte-to-char expansion and internal array doubling, to many times the raw payload size and can trigger OutOfMemoryError for the whole JVM. UTF8DataInputJsonParser was introduced in 2.8.0 together with createParser(DataInput); releases before 2.8.0 do not contain the affected class.

items.summary: RabbitMQ is a messaging and streaming broker. Prior to versions 3.13.15, 4.0.20, 4.1.11, 4.2.6, 4.3.0, When a binding is created on an x-jms-topic exchange, add_binding/3 reads the rjms_erlang_selector argument and passes it through erl_scan:string/1 then erl_parse:parse_term/1. erl_scan:string/1 interns every atom literal it tokenizes. validate_binding/2 is a no-op (-> ok.), there is no length cap, and the surrounding try/catch cannot reclaim atoms. items.title: RabbitMQ is a messaging and streaming broker. Prior to versions 3.13.15, 4.0.20, 4.1.11, 4.2.6, and 4.3.0, add_binding/3 parses the routing key as an integer weight N and comput...
items.summary: RabbitMQ is a messaging and streaming broker. Prior to versions 3.13.15, 4.0.20, 4.1.11, 4.2.6, and 4.3.0, add_binding/3 parses the routing key as an integer weight N and computes ring positions with lists:seq(NextN0, NextN0 + N - 1). validate_binding/2 only checks N >= 1 , no upper bound. The resulting list is stored in the exchange's Khepri record, replicated cluster-wide, and reloaded on restart. A user with write permission on a consistent-hash exchange and read on a queue can create a binding whose routing key (the hash-ring weight) is an arbitrarily large integer. The broker allocates a list of that many integers via lists:seq/2 and persists it to Khepri across all cluster nodes , a single binding with weight 100000000 allocates ~800 MB on every node and survives restarts. Preconditions include rabbitmq_consistent_hash_exchange plugin enabled write permission on a consistent-hash exchange + read on a queue (standard binding perms). This issue is fixed in versions 3.13.15, 4.0.20, 4.1.11, 4.2.6, and 4.3.0.

The HTTP handler omits this call entirely. A user with management tag and vhost access , but no configure permission on any resource , can create super-streams (an exchange + N partition stream queues + bindings) via the HTTP API. The native stream-protocol path enforces configure on each resource; the HTTP path does not, creating a privilege escalation from 'can view' to 'can create persistent cluster-wide resources.' Preconditions include rabbitmq_stream_management plugin enabled management tag + vhost access (no resource permissions needed). This issue is fixed in versions 4.0.22, 4.1.11, 4.2.6, and 4.3.0.

items.summary: Wire provides gRPC and protocol buffers for Android, Kotlin, Swift, and Java. ProtoReader.readData() forwards the negative count to ReadBuffer.readData(count:), whose upper-bound-only check permits the value to reach Foundation Data(bytes:count:) and trigger an unrecoverable process trap instead of a catchable ProtoDecoder.Error. Any Swift process decoding untrusted protobuf bytes can be crashed without authentication, user interaction, or knowledge of the target schema. This issue is fixed in versions 6.4.1 and 7.0.0-alpha04.

items.title: The Reachy Mini Bluetooth service asks a connecting device for a PIN before it will accept commands. The check protects the session but not the caller, so an attacker in Bluetoo...
items.summary:
The Reachy Mini Bluetooth service asks a connecting device for a PIN before it will accept commands. The check protects the session but not the caller, so an attacker in Bluetooth range can ride along on someone else's successful authentication.



The authenticated state is kept in a single shared flag on the service instance rather than per device. BlueZ passes the calling device's identity to the characteristic write handler in the options argument, but WriteValue(self, value, options) in src/reachy_mini/daemon/app/services/bluetooth/bluetooth_service.py ignores options entirely. The handler therefore has no idea which device sent a given write, and it cannot tell the authenticated one from any other.



Once any device completes the PIN exchange, the flag is set and every nearby device can send CMD_ commands until it resets. An attacker simply waits within radio range for a legitimate user to authenticate, then writes commands into the same window. No PIN is ever guessed or brute-forced.



This is the second step of a three-step chain that JFrog documented against the robot. The first is the unrestricted file upload in the media sounds API, tracked as CVE-2026-55419, which places an attacker-controlled script on the filesystem. This issue then provides command access over Bluetooth. The third is the Bluetooth command handler path traversal, tracked as CVE-2026-62661, which runs that script as root.

items.title: The Reachy Mini daemon exposes an HTTP API for managing the robot. Its app installation endpoint, POST /apps/install in src/reachy_mini/daemon/app/routers/apps.py, has no authen...
items.summary:
The Reachy Mini daemon exposes an HTTP API for managing the robot. Its app installation endpoint, POST /apps/install in src/reachy_mini/daemon/app/routers/apps.py, has no authentication. The handler's only dependency is Depends(get_app_manager), which just hands back the manager object from application state, so nothing in the chain ever checks a credential.



The endpoint takes an AppInfo body naming a Hugging Face Space. The daemon downloads that Space and installs it as a Python package through install_package in src/reachy_mini/apps/sources/local_common_venv.py, using uv or pip. Installing a Python package runs the package's own build and setup code, so whoever chooses the Space chooses what code the robot runs. Anyone can publish a public Hugging Face Space, so this is not a meaningful restriction on the attacker.



How far this reaches depends on the model. In _resolve_bind_host in src/reachy_mini/daemon/app/main.py the daemon binds 0.0.0.0 when it runs as the wireless version and 127.0.0.1 otherwise, with the vendor's own comment explaining that the robot has to be reachable on the LAN. On a wireless unit, then, any host on the same network can install and run code on the robot without credentials.



One related change has already shipped but does not fix this. Version 1.8.2 replaced the wildcard CORS policy with an allow list of localhost and Tauri origins. That closes the browser drive-by route, where a web page the victim visits silently calls the endpoint in the background. It has no effect on this issue: CORS is enforced by browsers and governs whether script may read a response, while a direct HTTP request from another machine on the network involves no browser, no preflight and no CORS check at all.

items.title: Compatibility Test Suite (CTS)

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本次输入指向 Android 官方文档站点中的“Compatibility Test Suite (CTS)”（兼容性测试套件）页面，来源标注为 Android Security Bulletin（发布于 2026-09-24），但正文与摘要字段为空，未提供任何 CVE 编号、受影响产品/版本、漏洞成因、触发条件或实际影响描述。因此，这条记录本身并不构成一份可直接处置的漏洞公告，而更像是一条指向 CTS 文档入口的引用。从 Android 生态的定位来看，CTS 是一套用于验证设备实现是否符合 Android 兼容性定义（CDD）的自动化测试集合，OEM/ODM 在提交设备认证（如 GMS 认证）前必须通过；它同时被用作回归验证手段，确保系统镜像、厂商定制层与 API 行为保持一致。由于输入未给出任何具体缺陷信息，无法判断是否存在测试用例失效、权限校验不严、测试接口暴露（如 CTS 相关测试组件在正式版本中被保留）等潜在问题，也无法确认该条目是否会被后续更新为正式的安全公告条目。对防守方而言，当前可采取的动作有限：建议持续跟踪该页面的更新与 Android 月度安全公告（Security Bulletin）及 Pixel 更新公告的对应关系，确认后续是否补充 CVE、受影响版本区间与补丁级别；在资产侧核对在用 Android 设备的补丁级别与认证状态，避免将“兼容性测试”相关条目误判为已确认的可利用漏洞而触发无效应急流程。本摘要仅基于输入字段，未对缺失信息做任何推断。

items.title: update the software on your Mac

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该条信息来自 Apple 官方支持站点（support.apple.com，文档编号 108382），标题为“更新 Mac 上的软件”，属于 Apple 安全发布（Apple Security Releases）渠道的一部分。此类页面是 Apple 面向普通用户与 IT 管理员发布的通用指引，主要说明如何通过系统设置中的“软件更新”等入口检查并安装 macOS、iOS/iPadOS、Safari 及其他 Apple 软件的安全更新，并汇总指向当期安全内容说明（Security Content）文档的入口。本次抓取未附带正文摘要、受影响产品清单、CVE 编号、严重性评级与参考链接，因此无法从该条记录确认具体漏洞组件、受影响版本区间、攻击触发条件与实际影响范围；同时也没有任何信息表明存在已被在野利用的漏洞或已列入 CISA KEV 的情况。对防守方而言，该记录的价值在于它是一个官方更新渠道信号：提醒资产管理者确认 Apple 终端处于受支持版本并及时打补丁，而不是提供某一具体漏洞的技术细节。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Apple 官方更新指引页是判断终端是否需要升级的权威入口，但本条记录未给出 CVE、受影响版本与严重性，无法据此排定修复优先级；只能按“未知风险”处理，需回到对应安全内容文档补齐细节后再做补丁决策。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 本条记录本身不含可确认的漏洞影响描述，无法评估具体机密性、完整性或可用性后果；其作用是提示防守方核对 Apple 终端版本并及时安装厂商发布的安全更新。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 1) 通过系统设置中的软件更新入口或 App Store 检查并安装可用的安全更新；2) 在企业环境中使用 MDM 或补丁管理平台盘点 Apple 设备型号与系统版本，识别已停止支持或长期未更新的终端；3) 持续关注 Apple 官方 Security Releases 页面及对应的安全内容说明文档，以获取具体 CVE 与严重性评级；4) 在公告细节缺失期间按“未知风险”对待，优先保障对外可达与处理敏感数据的终端完成更新。

items.title: update the software on your iPhone or iPad

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本条目来自 Apple 官方安全发布渠道（Apple Security Releases），页面标题为“更新你的 iPhone 或 iPad 上的软件”，源地址为 support.apple.com/en-us/118575，发布时间标注为 2026-09-24。该页面属于 Apple 面向终端用户的安全更新指引类公告，核心诉求是提醒 iPhone 与 iPad 用户将设备操作系统升级到 Apple 当前提供的最新版本，从而获得其中包含的安全修复、稳定性改进与兼容性修正。需要明确的是，本次输入未附带任何正文摘录，未列出 CVE 编号，也未提供受影响的具体机型、iOS/iPadOS 版本区间、涉及的系统组件、漏洞技术成因、触发条件以及严重性评级，因此无法判断本次更新究竟修复了哪些缺陷，也无法判断是否存在可被远程或本地触发的内存破坏、权限提升、沙箱逃逸、Web 内容处理类问题，更无法评估实际影响范围。从公告性质推断，该页面通常对应一次或多次 iOS / iPadOS 系统更新，受影响资产即用户端 iPhone / iPad 上的系统软件及其内置组件；但在缺乏官方安全说明文档的情况下，任何关于具体漏洞类型与利用条件的推断都缺乏依据。对防守方而言，应将其视为需要持续跟进的厂商补丁提醒：核对内部移动终端当前系统版本与 Apple 最新发布版本之间的差距，规划升级窗口，并在该页面后续补充 CVE 列表或安全说明时再行评估风险等级与优先级。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 厂商官方渠道发布的更新提醒，说明 iPhone/iPad 系统存在需要修复的问题。移动终端常被用于访问企业邮箱与内网资源，及时跟进可减少已知缺陷带来的暴露面。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 1) 核对内部 iPhone/iPad 终端的系统版本，通过 Apple 官方渠道升级到最新版本；2) 升级前避免安装来源不明的配置描述文件或应用；3) 持续关注该页面后续是否补充 CVE 列表与安全说明文档；4) 若使用 MDM 等移动设备管理方案，统计未按期升级的设备并设定合规基线。

items.title: submit your research

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本次情报来源为 Apple 官方支持页面（support.apple.com/en-us/102549），标题为“submit your research”，发布时间为 2026-09-24。该页面在本次采集中未提供任何正文内容，既未列出受影响的产品与系统版本，也未附带 CVE 编号、严重性评级或任何参考链接。从标题语义判断，该页面更可能属于 Apple 安全赏金计划、漏洞研究提交入口或相关说明页，而非针对某一具体漏洞的安全公告（Security Advisory）。因此目前无法确认存在任何具体的安全缺陷、受影响组件、触发条件或实际影响，也无法判断其与任何已知漏洞是否相关。对防守方而言，本条记录仅代表“该来源页面被采集到”这一事实，不具备可用于资产排查、补丁优先级排序或检测规则编写的技术细节。建议将该条目视为待核实项：一方面重新抓取页面全文，确认其是否承载真实公告；另一方面与 Apple 官方 Security Releases 列表及 CISA KEV 目录交叉比对，确认是否存在对应的 CVE 条目。若最终确认其属于研究提交入口或流程说明页，则应将其从漏洞公告队列中剔除，避免在 SOC 告警流中形成噪声与误判。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 来源为 Apple 官方渠道，但抓取内容为空且无 CVE、无受影响产品、无严重性评级，当前不构成可操作的漏洞情报；需保留并复核，避免被误当作真实安全公告进入应急响应流程。

items.title: Get help with security issues

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本条目来源于苹果官方安全发布渠道（Apple Security Releases），标题为「Get help with security issues」，对应链接指向苹果支持站点上的一个通用安全帮助页面。与典型安全公告不同，该条目未附带任何正文摘要或漏洞描述，未列出 CVE 编号、受影响产品与版本、严重等级，也没有参考链接；vendors 字段仅标注为 Apple Security Releases，products 字段为空，severity 标记为 unknown。因此本条目前只能被判定为「指向苹果官方安全支持入口的索引性内容」，而非针对某一具体漏洞的公告。从防御视角看，此类页面通常用于说明用户如何报告安全问题、如何获取安全更新说明、以及如何判断设备上的软件版本是否需要升级；它本身并不代表存在新的可被利用漏洞，也不构成可执行的修复动作依据。由于缺少技术细节，无法判断漏洞成因、触发条件、攻击面或实际影响，任何关于受影响组件、攻击向量和影响范围的描述都缺乏事实支撑，不应据此下结论。建议将本条作为低优先级情报留存：一方面持续轮询该苹果官方页面及其关联的安全更新公告，等待出现具体 CVE、版本号与补丁信息后再行评估；另一方面在资产管理与补丁流程中，仍按既有节奏跟踪苹果各平台（iOS/iPadOS、macOS、Safari、watchOS、tvOS 等）的例行安全更新，避免因单条信息缺失而遗漏真实风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该条目仅指向苹果官方安全支持入口，不含漏洞细节、CVE 或受影响版本，无法直接驱动修复动作；但苹果产品安全更新频率高、覆盖面广，应将其纳入持续跟踪清单，待官方补充具体公告后再评估优先级。

llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 1) 将该条目登记为低优先级待补充情报，不基于此发起紧急变更；2) 定期复查苹果官方安全发布页面，关注后续是否出现具体 CVE、受影响版本与补丁信息；3) 按既有节奏维护苹果各平台资产清单，核对设备与系统版本，确保例行安全更新正常下发；4) 在补丁管理流程中保留苹果官方公告作为唯一权威来源，避免依据第三方转述决策；5) 若后续公告明确高危漏洞或已被在野利用（需有官方或 KEV 佐证），再升级为紧急修复任务。

items.title: Background Security Improvements

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本条信息来自 Apple 官方安全发布页面（support.apple.com/en-us/102657），标题为《Background Security Improvements》（后台安全改进）。该页面属于 Apple 面向用户的通用安全更新说明入口，主要用于介绍 Apple 通过独立于完整操作系统升级的方式，向已受支持的设备快速推送针对特定组件（历史上主要涉及 Safari 浏览器及其 WebKit 渲染引擎，也可能涵盖其他系统组件）的安全修复机制。这一机制的意义在于：当出现不需要等待下一个大版本系统更新即可处置的安全问题时，Apple 可以先以较小的独立更新包形式下发修补，缩短从问题确认到用户设备获得防护之间的窗口期。

需要特别说明的是，本次输入中并没有提供任何具体的技术细节：没有列出任何 CVE 编号，没有指明受影响的具体产品、型号或操作系统版本，也没有说明漏洞成因（例如是内存破坏、类型混淆、越界访问还是逻辑缺陷）、触发条件、攻击面（本地还是远程、是否需要用户交互）、以及实际影响（是否可导致代码执行、沙箱逃逸、信息泄露或权限提升）。给出的严重性字段为 unknown，也没有提供任何参考链接、补丁版本号或时间线信息。因此，本摘要无法对具体风险的严重程度做出判断，也不应据此推断存在正在被利用的安全事件。

从防守方视角看，该页面本身更接近“机制说明 + 更新入口”性质的公告，其可操作价值在于提醒管理员：Apple 设备可能存在一类不随完整系统版本号显著变化的独立安全更新，仅依赖固定的年度或季度系统升级窗口进行补丁核对，可能会遗漏这类单独下发的修复。建议将其纳入常规的资产与补丁核查流程，持续关注官方页面的后续更新内容。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Apple 的“后台安全改进”可能绕过常规系统大版本更新节奏单独下发修复，只按系统版本号做补丁核查的团队容易漏掉这类更新，形成防护盲区。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 1) 将其纳入 Apple 资产清单的常规补丁核查流程，不依赖系统版本号变化判断是否已修补；2) 确保受管 Apple 设备启用自动更新与快速安全响应类更新策略；3) 定期人工查看该官方页面及 Apple 安全发布索引，记录更新内容与适用版本；4) 在 MDM/终端管理平台中统计当前 Safari/WebKit 与系统版本分布，识别长期未更新的设备；5) 未获得具体 CVE 与影响范围前，不针对该条目启动应急响应，仅做跟踪与资产盘点。

items.title: PocsuitePocsuite 是由知道创宇安全研究团队打造的一款开源的远程漏洞测试框架。它是知道创宇安全研究团队发展的基石，是团队发展至今一直维护的一个项目，保障了我们的 Web安全研究能力的领先。

llm_summary.summary_zh:
本条输入并非一份漏洞公告，而是知道创宇（Knownsec）/ Seebug 安全研究团队对其开源远程漏洞测试框架 Pocsuite 的项目介绍页面。Pocsuite 由知道创宇安全研究团队打造并长期维护，定位为开源远程漏洞测试框架，主要用于对目标系统进行远程漏洞的 PoC（概念验证）验证与批量测试；使用者可编写、组织并批量执行验证脚本，配合 Seebug 等漏洞平台生态用于授权范围内的安全测试与漏洞研究。它是该团队 Web 安全研究能力的基础设施之一。

从防守方视角需要明确：输入内容中没有给出任何具体漏洞的成因描述、受影响组件与版本、触发条件、影响范围或利用方式，也没有 CVE 编号、参考链接、厂商补丁信息与严重性评级。因此本条不能用于判断任何实际漏洞风险，也不应被当作修复依据。

其安全含义主要体现在工具层面：此类 PoC 框架属于攻击面工具链的一部分，在授权测试、红队评估以及非授权攻击场景中均可能被使用，防守方若在主机进程、网络流量或日志中发现该类框架的特征行为，可能意味着存在漏洞扫描或漏洞验证活动，应结合资产暴露面与访问来源进行研判。同时，组织内部若使用同类框架开展自查，必须严格限定授权范围、访问控制与留存审计记录，避免测试行为影响生产系统。此外，介绍页面提到的时间戳与公告性质不符（未包含漏洞披露内容），不应据此推断存在新的安全事件。若需跟进真实风险，应持续关注 Seebug 平台的漏洞公告与该项目的版本更新。

items.title: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DIR-825 3.00b32. Affected is the function tunnel_set_params of the file tunnel.c of the component rp-l2tp. The manipulation of the argum...
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DIR-825 3.00b32. Affected is the function tunnel_set_params of the file tunnel.c of the component rp-l2tp. The manipulation of the argument peer_hostname  leads to out-of-bounds write. The attack may be initiated remotely.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-96891 是 D-Link DIR-825 无线路由器固件 3.00b32 版本中被披露的一个严重内存破坏漏洞。问题位于固件集成的 rp-l2tp 组件（开源 L2TP 协议实现，负责隧道建立与 L2TP 控制报文处理），具体落在 tunnel.c 文件的 tunnel_set_params 函数中。该函数在处理 peer_hostname（对端主机名）参数时未对输入长度做充分校验，导致越界写（out-of-bounds write），可覆盖相邻内存结构，破坏程序控制流或数据完整性。由于 peer_hostname 一般来自 L2TP 控制连接中携带的对端信息，攻击者无需任何认证即可从网络侧远程触发该缺陷，CVSS 3.1 基础评分为 9.8（AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U，机密性、完整性、可用性影响均为高）。成功利用可能造成设备崩溃、拒绝服务，在该类嵌入式环境中还存在进一步实现任意代码执行、从而完全接管路由器的风险。当前 NVD 元数据未标注该漏洞已进入 CISA KEV 列表或在野利用，也无 EPSS 评分，属于技术缺陷已确认、实际利用情况未知的状态。D-Link DIR-825 属较早期产品线，需确认厂商是否仍在维护并提供修复固件。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 9.8 分、无需认证的远程越界写，作用于路由器边缘常见的 L2TP 服务；一旦利用成功可能导致设备被完全接管，并成为进入内网的跳板。DIR-825 多为家庭或小型办公出口设备，长期暴露且补丁能力弱。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 远程未认证攻击者可向受影响设备发送特制的 L2TP 相关报文触发越界写，导致设备崩溃、重启或服务不可用；在嵌入式环境中还可能被进一步利用实现代码执行，造成配置篡改、流量劫持与内网横向渗透。

items.summary: Laravel-Mediable 7.0.0 before 7.0.2 contains an incomplete patch for CVE-2026-49972 in which the .pht extension is absent from the forbidden_extensions blocklist in config/mediable.php. The blocklist introduced to address CVE-2026-49972 includes phpt but omits pht, which Apache executes as PHP via the default FilesMatch directive on Debian and Ubuntu systems. An attacker can upload a .pht file that passes all validation in MediaUploader::verifyExtension() and File::sanitizeFileName() because pht is not present in the blocklist, causing the file to be written to disk and executed as PHP when requested, enabling remote code execution with the privileges of the web server process.

items.summary:
A flaw was found in the Ansible Automation Platform automation-controller. When a
WorkflowJobTemplate is copied, the deep-copy permission sanitizer validates only the inventory,
unified_job_template, and credentials of each cloned node and fails to check the instance_groups
(and execution_environment and labels) that were preserved from the original. A user with
organization workflow-admin permission but no role on the referenced instance groups can copy a
workflow, become its administrator, and launch jobs pinned to instance groups they are not
authorized to use — including the control-plane instance group — bypassing the InstanceGroup
use_role boundary and causing attacker-influenced automation to run in the control-plane
execution context.

items.summary:
A flaw was found in Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform's automation-
controller. The Project scm_url field is not validated against values that
begin with a dash and is stored and passed verbatim to the git SCM module.
Because the module runs git ls-remote with the URL as a positional argument and
without a "--" separator, a git project URL such as "--upload-pack=<command>:x"
is interpreted by git as the --upload-pack option and executed via a shell. A
user with permission to create or modify a project in a single organization can
thereby execute arbitrary commands on the control-plane task pod, with output
reflected through the project update stdout endpoint, leading to cross-tenant
compromise and in-cluster lateral movement

items.summary: OpenC3 COSMOS provides the functionality needed to send commands to and receive data from one or more embedded systems. From 5.1.0 until 7.3.0, authenticated non-administrator users can write content under targets_modified/ that is later executed by multiple configuration paths below the intended code-execution privilege tier. Table and command or telemetry definitions are processed through ConfigParser, PacketConfig, GENERIC_READ_CONVERSION, or GENERIC_WRITE_CONVERSION, allowing ERB rendering or Ruby and Python evaluation, while openc3-cosmos-script-runner-api/scripts/run_suite_analysis.rb executes suite procedure files through require. Storage uploads, screen saves, and script creation can place content in the overlay, and triggering table processing, a cmd/tlm reload, or suite analysis executes the content in cmd-tlm-api, decom microservices, or Script Runner with access to internal credentials and data. This issue is fixed in version 7.3.0.

items.summary: Moquette is a lightweight Java MQTT broker. Prior to 0.18.1, when pattern-based ACL rules are configured, AuthorizationsCollector.canDoOperation substitutes client ID and username values directly into rules containing %c or %u and then treats the result as an MQTT topic filter. A client that uses + or # in either identity can broaden the substituted filter and gain cross-tenant read and write access. A # identity can also produce an invalid filter that triggers a NullPointerException in Topic.match and disrupts session processing. This issue is fixed in version 0.18.1.

Inconsistent interpretation of HTTP/2 requests ('HTTP Request/Response smuggling') vulnerability in Apache Tomcat caused by a regression in fix for CVE-2026-41293 can trigger request header mix-up.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.22 through 11.0.25, from 10.1.55 through 10.1.59, from 9.0.118 through 9.0.121.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.26, 10.1.60 or 9.0.122, which fix the issue.

items.title: Improper link resolution before file access ('link following') vulnerability in the `tar` source plugin of Apache BuildStream running on Python < 3.12 allows malicious source ta...
items.summary:
Improper link resolution before file access ('link following') vulnerability in the `tar` source plugin of Apache BuildStream running on Python < 3.12 allows malicious source tarballs to write files on the host, with the privileges of the user running BuildStream, via symlinks as part of source fetching.
The impact of this issue is mitigated by:

* BuildStream projects should only use trusted sources in their elements as otherwise the build output can also not be trusted
* Tracking a source tarball pins its SHA256 hash, which prevents MITM attacks of users that are fetching an already tracked project
* When running on Python >= 3.12, BuildStream >= 2.3.0 already makes use of the Python `tarfile` filter functionality, which blocks the symlink escape

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.8.1, which fixes this issue.

items.summary: MCP Atlassian is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Atlassian products (Confluence and Jira). Prior to 0.22.0, requests to the HTTP MCP endpoint without a per-user identity are allowed to reach tool handlers, which then use globally configured Jira or Confluence credentials. A network caller can perform operations with the operator account's permissions unless the deployment has an independent authentication boundary. The advisory traces the vulnerable input and processing flow through streamable-http, UserTokenMiddleware, _get_fetcher, and global credentials, which identify the affected entry points, controls, and code paths. This issue is fixed in version 0.22.0.

items.summary:
plone.app.portlets.portlets provides a Plone-specific user interface for plone.portlets, as well as a standard set of portlets that ship with Plone. Starting in version 5.0.0 and prior to versions 5.0.8, 6.0.4, and 7.0.2, the Classic portlet (plone.app.portlets.portlets.classic) used its user-supplied template/macro fields to build a TALES path expression that was then evaluated by the TAL path() helper. Because the value was interpreted as a full TALES expression, a user able to add or edit a Classic portlet could supply a crafted value that escapes simple path traversal and is evaluated as arbitrary code. This is exploitable by any authenticated user who can configure a Classic portlet - which, with the default role map, includes regular users on their personal dashboard. The result is code execution in the context of the Plone process, i.e. a privilege escalation across the trust boundary between an authenticated web user and the server-side process. The problem has been patched in `plone.app.portlets` 5.0.8, 6.0.4, and 7.0.2. Some workarounds are available. Restrict who can manage portlets: remove the `plone.app.portlets.ManageOwnPortlets` permission from untrusted roles, and limit Manage portlets to trusted administrators (usually this is already restricted to the Manager and Site Administrator roles). Where the Classic portlet is not needed, unregister it so it cannot be added. This would need to be done by editing a `portlets.xml` in your own code. One may also effectively disable showing the classic portlet by customising its template. In the Zope Management Interface go to the `portal_view_customizations` tool, locate the `classic.pt` template and click it. Click the Customize button. Remove all text and replace it with `
The classic portlet was disabled.
`. (This is not a recommended way of customizing a template, but in this case it is quite effective.)

items.summary: MCP Atlassian is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Atlassian products (Confluence and Jira). Prior to 0.22.0, the HTTP transport accepts requests without a verified user identity and downstream fetcher construction falls back to the operator's globally configured Jira or Confluence credentials. A network client that can reach the MCP endpoint can invoke Atlassian tools as the operator, including read and write operations available to that account. The advisory traces the vulnerable input and processing flow through UserTokenMiddleware, AtlassianOpaqueTokenVerifier, _get_fetcher, and streamable-http, which identify the affected entry points, controls, and code paths. This issue is fixed in version 0.22.0.

items.title: In OpenStack Swift before 2.38.2, the tempurl middleware does not reject the X-Copy-From header...
items.summary: In OpenStack Swift before 2.38.2, the tempurl middleware does not reject the X-Copy-From header on PUT requests. A TempURL signature only covers the method, expiry, and path, and thus the list of disallowed headers is the only defense against a signed PUT request changing what the request does. An attacker holding a PUT TempURL for a single object can add an X-Copy-From header naming any object in the same account; the copy middleware copies that object to the destination, and the attacker then reads the victim's data back with a GET TempURL for the destination object. Copies across account boundaries are rejected. Only deployments using the shipped default proxy pipeline (tempurl and copy middleware) with account-level TempURL keys are affected.

items.title: The EthPress – Web3 Login plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass in all...
items.summary: The EthPress – Web3 Login plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.5. This is due to the verify_login() function in app/Login.php containing a missing return statement in the signature verification failure branch — when Signature::verify2() reports a mismatch, the function only assigns a WP_Error to a local variable and continues executing, causing unconditional fall-through to the login block where Address::log_in() calls wp_set_auth_cookie() regardless of whether the submitted signature is valid. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to log in as any WordPress user who has a linked wallet address — including administrators — by submitting that user's public wallet address alongside an arbitrary well-formed signature, enabling full site takeover.

items.title: The Import and export users and customers plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege...
items.summary: The Import and export users and customers plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 2.4.17 via the plugin's own export and re-import workflow. The vulnerability exists because the exporter writes CSV cells using fputcsv() with a NUL byte (\0) as the escape character, while the importer parses the same file using SplFileObject::fgetcsv() with only a single delimiter argument, causing PHP's default backslash escape character to be applied instead; because the export column layout places display_name immediately before the role column and nickname immediately after, an attacker can store crafted values in those two profile fields — saved by WordPress core via the standard profile page — such that the escape mismatch causes the parser to merge the display_name cell into the role field and rebalance the column count via nickname, yielding administrator as the parsed role for their own row when it reaches the import_user function's add_role function. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access or above to escalate their privileges to Administrator. Exploitation requires a site administrator to trigger the plugin's documented export re-import migration with both "Update existing users" and "Update roles for existing users" set to "yes".

items.title: elysia has Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity and Interpretation Conflict
items.summary:
Elysia v1.4.28 is vulnerable to denial-of-service attacks due to CPU exhaustion in the form data normalization code.

Elysia uses `getAll` to retrieve value from FormData. It is called directly relative to the total number of key-value pairs in the form data. The total amount of work the for loop has to do grows quadratically, so doubling the number of unique key-value pairs quadruples the amount of work. In the above PoC, each .getAll call scans through all of the `n` key-value pairs in the form data. Because there are `n` unique keys in the form data, there are .getAll calls, so in total the form data normalizer has to scan `n` x `n` key-value pairs.

### Impact
Endpoints using `multipart/form-data`

### Patches
1.4.29

### Workarounds
no 100% confirm workaround beside updating the patch

items.title: plone.app.dexterity has a Denial of Service due to excessive title or description length
items.summary:
### Impact
When creating content with a very large title or description field, Plone can become unresponsive. Even if the content loads, it can be hard to edit or delete, because the UI is unwieldy.

### Patches
The problem has been patched in `plone.app.dexterity`.

* On Plone 6.2, upgrade to `plone.app.dexterity` 5.0.1.
* On Plone 6.1, upgrade to `plone.app.dexterity` 4.1.3.
* On Plone 6.0, upgrade to `plone.app.dexterity` 3.2.3.

Another part of this problem has been patched in `plone.app.contenttypes`. See [this advisory](https://github.com/plone/plone.app.contenttypes/security/advisories/GHSA-8pcw-h6w9-h46g).

### Workarounds
There are no known workarounds.

This problem was responsibly reported by Aldin Visnjic to the [Plone/Zope Security Team](mailto:security@plone.org). Thank you!

Note: The Plone/Zope Security team felt that the kind of fixes that were needed could be disruptive in corner cases if they were not careful. So they decided to develop the fixes publicly, giving the whole community the chance the review, and giving them the benefit from early feedback.

A flaw was found in the Ansible Automation Platform automation controller. The
external logging ...
items.summary:
A flaw was found in the Ansible Automation Platform automation controller. The
external logging (rsyslog) configuration is generated by interpolating
user-controlled settings — LOG_AGGREGATOR_HOST, LOG_AGGREGATOR_MAX_DISK_USAGE_PATH
and LOG_AGGREGATOR_RSYSLOGD_ERROR_LOG_FILE — into an rsyslog RainerScript config
file without neutralizing RainerScript syntax. A privileged (superuser) user can
inject rsyslog directives, including an omprog action, causing arbitrary command
execution inside the control-plane rsyslog component. This allows disclosure of
the controller SECRET_KEY and database credentials, decryption of all stored
credentials, and full compromise of the control plane.

items.title: An argument-injection flaw was found in the Ansible Automation Platform automation-controller...
items.summary:
An argument-injection flaw was found in the Ansible Automation Platform automation-controller
system-job subsystem. The system-job template launch endpoint stores a user-supplied "days"
variable without running the integer validation defined elsewhere for that field, and the
dispatcher flattens the management-command argument list into a single string with spaces before
the job runner re-splits it, so spaces in the value become additional command-line arguments.
Because system jobs are executed in-process on the control node without the container isolation
applied to all other job types, an authenticated user with superuser privileges can inject
arbitrary arguments — including Python's path option — into the control-plane awx-manage process,
controlling its argument vector and the first entry of its module search path. Full remote code
execution requires an additional import gadget that is not present in the current management
commands, so the demonstrated impact is argument injection with control of the process search
path rather than confirmed code execution.

items.title:
A server-side request forgery flaw was found in the Ansible Automation Platform
automation...
items.summary:
A server-side request forgery flaw was found in the Ansible Automation Platform
automation-controller email notification backend. The email backend passes the user-supplied SMTP
host and port from a notification template directly to the SMTP client without validating that
the target is not an internal, loopback, link-local, or reserved address. An authenticated user
with organization notification-admin permission can create or modify an email notification
template pointing at an arbitrary internal address, trigger a test, and have the controller task
process open a raw TCP connection to that address. The resulting connection error is reflected
back through the notification record, providing a three-state internal port-scan oracle (open,
closed, filtered) over the control-plane's cluster network, including the in-cluster Kubernetes
API. When a shared organization template holds a stored SMTP password, redirecting the host can
also cause that credential to be transmitted to an attacker-controlled server.
